B has small panel dots and a defined nose tip, so it reads slightly more like a constructed object than A's plain, toy-like body.
A has rivet dots on the body and a capped nose, which is slightly closer to the detailed real vehicles than B's bare shell.
B has small rivets on the body and a defined tip, which gives it a bit more of the built detail the real cards show.
B has a riveted seam at the nose and a riveted porthole ring, much like the real submarine's riveted bands and portholes, so it reads more like a real object.
A has a riveted nose band and a riveted porthole ring, which matches the real submarine's construction detail better than B's scattered dots.
